summary: Treat connected neural software as a maintained system whose faults and unauthorized changes can affect users over years.
outcomes: Build a threat model tied to device functions and user consequences.
Specify update, monitoring, rollback and support requirements.
sequence: Map assets, interfaces and trust boundaries
Connect threats to loss of availability, integrity and privacy
Introduce authentication, least privilege and software inventories
Connect postmarket learning to risk records

visual.question: What happens if a network service disappears or an update fails?
visual.interaction: Inject fictional availability and update faults into a software-only state machine.

practice.task: Write a maintenance and threat-model packet for a fictional neural recorder.
practice.success: Includes failure recovery, dependencies, user communication and bounded support assumptions.
